text:
Tower of amber walls,
+solitary laurel in a stone plaza,
+an unforeseen gulf,
+a smile in a dark corridor,
+the gait of a river flowing between palaces,
+sweet comet that blinds me and recedes…
+
+
+Bridge beneath whose arches life forever runs.

translation.title: Salvos
translation.editorial_note: Salvas is retained as the multivalent Salvos—salutes, bursts, and acts of saving—while the sequence of metaphoric glimpses flows into the final bridge.
